newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks close lower in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks close lower in light trade.

text.p: Thai stocks ended mostly lower on Wednesday on sluggish trade with finance and buidling materials companies leading the decline, brokers said.
The SET index eased 3.70 points to close at 552.87 on 2.65 billion baht turnover. The SET-50 index fell 0.33 points to 40.02.
"Finance and building materials issues were big losers today. New buying interest was also absent," said a broker at Ekkapat Finance and Securities.
Declines led advances 169 to 104 with 89 issues closing unchanged.

Brokers said lingering concern about the sluggish economy and liquidity problems of the finance sector still dampened sentiment. "It is unlikely to see a market rally in the near term. Economic and finance sector problems remain major concerns," the broker said.
Finance One finished at 5.20 baht, down 0.50 from the previous close. It topped the active list with 175 million baht of its shares traded.
Heavy-weight industrial group Siam Cement fell 22 to 468.
